description: Before writing a message, email, post or free-text form answer for the user, submit it as content with a claim binding for each amount, number, date, identifier, commitment or relationship statement. Each binding rests on a verified fact from alterlab_facts, a user-authored mark, a quoted source or, for a commitment, the limit fact that caps it. Returns status pass, blocked (unsupported_claim, claim_mismatch, commitment_exceeds_limit, unsupported_relationship) or needs_human_review, the claims found, what each bound to and a content_hash that approvals bind to. Narrative with no checkable claim passes. Deterministic and free: no model call.

claims.description: One binding per claim in the text

claim.description: The claim as written in the text, e.g. EUR 39.90

text.description: The exact text to be written

must_be_user_authored.description: Mark the text as a personal statement only the user may author

name: alterlab_content_check
